name: Monaco Editor Plugin UI
description: DOM structure and interactions for the Monaco editor plugin's tabbed editing interface. Documents the editor wrapper, tab bar with scrollable tab container, Monaco editor mount area, tab interactions (switch, close, drag-reorder, context menu, middle-click close), file open/close/external-reload flows, auto-save and manual save paths, dirty state rendering, and editor selection state broadcasting.

dom.root: .editor-wrap (this.el) — flex column layout wrapping tab bar and editor area

elements.editor_tab_bar: .editor-tab-bar (this.bar) — horizontal tab strip bar containing the scrollable tab container
elements.editor_tab_scroll: .editor-tab-scroll (this.tabContainer) — overflow-x auto scroll container for tabs, with manual scrollLeft adjustment to keep active tab visible
elements.editor_area: .editor-area (this.editorEl) — Monaco editor mount point with unique id="monaco-{crypto.randomUUID()}"
elements.editor_empty: .editor-empty span — 'No file selected' placeholder text shown in tab container when no tabs are open, removed when first tab is added

tab_structure.container: .editor-tab (this.el) — per-tab div, set draggable=true for drag-and-drop reorder
tab_structure.name_span: .editor-tab-name — span displaying the file name (no path)
tab_structure.close_btn: .editor-tab-close — span showing '✕' character, click handler with e.stopPropagation()
tab_structure.title_attr: title attribute set to full filePath on each tab div for hover tooltip

states.active: .is-active — applied when this tab is the currently active tab (tab.filePath === this.activeTab)
states.dirty: .is-dirty — applied when the file has unsaved changes (activeTab is in dirtyFiles Set). Toggled via updateDirtyState() which calls classList.toggle on the active tab element
states.dragging: .is-dragging — applied to the source tab during dragstart, removed on document-level dragend listener
states.dragover: .is-dragover — applied to a potential drop target tab on dragenter, removed on dragleave or drop

interactions.name: open_file
interactions.trigger: File double-click in FileExplorerPlugin (delegated through ExplorerPlugin.openFile)
interactions.action: Normalize path (backslashes to forward slashes, lowercased for key) → check if tab with lcPath already exists → if exists: switchTab(lcPath); if new: read file content via IPC fs:readFile → push { filePath: lcPath, name, originalPath: normalized } to tabs → switchTab(lcPath) → fire onStateChange
interactions.result: New tab appears in tab bar with file content loaded in editor, language syntax highlighting applied

interactions.name: switch_tab
interactions.action: Save current editor state: store current content in fileContents map for activeTab → save cursor position (lineNumber, column) and scrollTop to savedCursors map → update activeTab to lcPath → load stored content from fileContents into editor with suppressDirty=true → restore saved cursor/scroll position from savedCursors if available → detect language from file extension via getLanguage(ext) → set Monaco model language → renderTabs() → sendEditorState() with 150ms debounce
interactions.result: Editor content switches to selected tab's file, cursor/scroll restored, tab bar reflects new active state

interactions.name: close_tab
interactions.trigger: Click on .editor-tab-close span or middle-click (button === 1) on .editor-tab
interactions.action: Remove tab from tabs array → delete from fileContents map → delete from dirtyFiles set → if closed tab was active: neighbor fallback (Math.min(idx, tabs.length - 1)) or clear editor if no tabs remain → renderTabs() → sendEditorState() → fire onStateChange
interactions.propagation: Close button click handler calls e.stopPropagation() to prevent switch_tab from also firing
interactions.result: Tab removed from bar; if it was active, editor switches to adjacent tab or shows empty state

interactions.name: drag_reorder
interactions.trigger: dragstart on source .editor-tab → dragenter/dragover/dragleave/drop on target .editor-tab
interactions.gesture: dragstart: e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', tab.filePath), add .is-dragging class → dragover: e.preventDefault() → dragenter: e.preventDefault(), add .is-dragover class → dragleave: remove .is-dragover class → drop: e.preventDefault(), remove .is-dragover, read draggedPath from dataTransfer, splice tab from fromIdx to toIdx in tabs array → renderTabs() → fire onStateChange
interactions.result: Tabs reordered in tab bar to match new tabs array order; active tab selection preserved

interactions.name: context_menu
interactions.action: e.preventDefault() and e.stopPropagation() → new ContextMenu([{Close: closeTab}, {Close Others: closeOtherTabs}, {Close All: closeAllTabs}, {separator}, {Copy File Path: clipboard.writeText(originalPath)}], e.clientX, e.clientY)
interactions.result: Floating context menu appears at click position with tab management actions

interactions.name: auto_save
interactions.action: If activeTab set and suppressDirty is false: add activeTab to dirtyFiles Set → updateDirtyState() toggles .is-dirty on active tab element. Then debounce (clear previous timer, set new 1500ms setTimeout) → saveCurrentFile() writes content via IPC fs:writeFile → delete activeTab from dirtyFiles → updateDirtyState() clears .is-dirty class
interactions.timing: 1500ms debounce — timer resets on each content change

interactions.name: manual_save
interactions.trigger: Ctrl+S keybinding (registered as Monaco editor action with id 'save-file')
interactions.action: Immediate saveCurrentFile() — write editor content via IPC fs:writeFile, clear dirty flag, update dirty indicator

interactions.name: file_changed_external
interactions.trigger: fs.onChanged callback from preload (registered in constructor as this.unsubFileChanged)
interactions.action: Normalize rawPath (backslashes to forward slashes, lowercased) → reloadIfOpen(lcPath): find tab by lcPath → read file via IPC fs:readFile → if content is null (file deleted): closeTab(lcPath); if content changed and tab is active and editor exists: compare with editor.getValue(), if different use suppressDirty=true + editor.setValue(content) + suppressDirty=false to avoid spurious dirty marking
interactions.result: External file changes reflected in editor; deleted files close their tab

interactions.name: editor_selection_change
interactions.action: Debounced 150ms via sendEditorState(): get active original path → if no path, send ide:editorState with null values → if editor: get selection, check if non-collapsed (startLine/startColumn !== endLine/endColumn) → if non-collapsed: get selected text from model via getValueInRange → send IPC ide:editorState with { filePath, text, selection: { startLine, startColumn, endLine, endColumn } }
interactions.timing: 150ms debounce; previous timer cleared on each selection change

interactions.name: close_others
interactions.trigger: 'Close Others' in tab right-click context menu
interactions.action: Keep only the right-clicked tab → set tabs = [keptTab] → clear fileContents and dirtyFiles, re-add kept tab's content → clear savedCursors → set activeTab = keptTab → load kept content in editor with suppressDirty → renderTabs() → sendEditorState() → fire onStateChange

interactions.name: close_all
interactions.trigger: 'Close All' in tab right-click context menu
interactions.action: Clear all state: tabs = [], fileContents.clear(), dirtyFiles.clear(), savedCursors = {}, activeTab = null → clear editor with suppressDirty → renderTabs() (shows 'No file selected' dummy) → sendEditorState() → fire onStateChange

interactions.name: copy_file_path
interactions.trigger: 'Copy File Path' in tab right-click context menu
interactions.action: IPC clipboard.writeText(tab.originalPath) — copies the full original OS file path to system clipboard

states.empty: tabs.length === 0, activeTab === null. Tab container shows .editor-empty span 'No file selected'. Editor displays empty content. No dirty indicators.
states.loaded: One or more tabs in tabs array. Tab bar shows .editor-tab elements. Active tab marked with .is-active class. Editor displays file content with language-specific syntax highlighting (matched via file extension → getLanguage). Cursor/scroll position restored from savedCursors map.
states.dirty: Active tab has unsaved content changes — .is-dirty class applied to the active .editor-tab element. dirtyFiles Set tracks which files are dirty. Auto-save clears dirty after 1.5s debounce; manual Ctrl+S clears immediately.
states.external_deleted: A file open in a tab was deleted outside Cockpit. Detected via fs.onChanged callback. reloadIfOpen receives null content → closeTab automatically. If deleted file was active, editor switches to neighbor or enters empty state.

rendering.tab_scroll: Active tab auto-scrolled into view via manual scrollLeft calculation in renderTabs(): checks if active tab is left of current scroll or right of visible area, adjusts container.scrollLeft accordingly
rendering.dirty_indicator: .is-dirty class toggled via updateDirtyState() which reads dirtyFiles Set and calls classList.toggle on the active .editor-tab element
rendering.monaco_bootstrap: Shared monacoReady promise at module scope ensures Monaco CSS (editor.main.css), AMD loader (loader.js), and custom theme definitions run exactly once across all MonacoEditorPlugin instances. If window.monaco already exists (another instance bootstrapped), only createEditorInstance runs
rendering.monaco_themes: cockpit-dark: base vs-dark, editor background #0A0E14, foreground #C8D6E5, cursor #C8D6E5, selection #2A3A4A. cocktail-light: base vs, editor background #f8f8f8, foreground #1a1a1a, cursor #1a1a1a, selection #e0e0e0
